name: Magpie
title: Magpie: free Lossless Scaling alternative
caption:
Lossless Scaling costs $6.99 on Steam. Magpie upscales your games for free 🎮

✅ One shortcut upscales the window you're playing
✅ FSR, Anime4K and retro CRT filters built in
✅ FPS counter and screenshots in the toolbar
✅ No subscription, no ads, 100% free

💻 Windows
ℹ️ Windows 10 (1903+) or 11 and a DirectX 11 GPU. Magpie upscales only; it has no frame generation like Lossless Scaling. Lossless Scaling price is the one-time Steam price

Comment "GAMES" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

dm_pitch: Magpie, the free open-source Lossless Scaling alternative 🎮

beats.say: There's a free app that makes your games look sharper, and nobody talks about it.
Lossless Scaling costs seven bucks on Steam. Magpie costs nothing.
On Windows, press one shortcut, and it upscales whatever window you're playing.
Pick a sharp upscaler, or a retro CRT filter that makes games look like an old TV.
Thousands of gamers on GitHub keep it free.
